{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Filter out QA orders
sales_clean = sales[~sales['revenue_clean'].isin([999999.99])]

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN
sales_clean['customer_age'] = sales_clean['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = sales_clean[sales_clean['converted'] == 1]

# Compute mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the exact value to ensure it's in the output
print(f"Computed mean age of converted customers: {mean_age_converted}")"}
